sourceTitle: Scientists complete largest wiring diagram and functional map of the brain to date
quote: The Machine Intelligence from Cortical Networks (MICrONS) Project has built the most detailed wiring diagram of a mammalian brain to date. Today, scientists published the scientific findings from this massive data resource in a collection of ten studies in the *Nature* family of journals. The wiring diagram and its data, freely available through the MICrONS Explorer, are 1.6 petabytes in size (equivalent to 22 years of non-stop HD video), and offer never-before-seen insight into brain function and organization of the visual system.
note: Producer reports aggregate resource size; no raw/processed partition. Not the >2 PB raw acquisition claim. Mirrors on AWS/Google/BossDB are the same dataset.
